verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs explicitly claim to 'store embeddings and run similarity search to power AI features,' and its PostgreSQL database offering documents pgvector installation, giving a concrete vector-search path. However, this is only first-party doc snippets with no tutorial depth, code examples, or independent/hands-on corroboration of actual similarity-search usage. Missing for 10: detailed how-to docs/tutorial for embedding storage and vector query API, independent/community validation of the feature working in practice.
